endpoints.label: List transcription factors
endpoints.describes: All transcription factors with curated ChIP-seq-derived binding profiles in UniBind.

endpoints.label: Single TF detail
endpoints.describes: Per-TF metadata + the list of TFBS datasets that target it. Use name lookups from unibind_factors first.

endpoints.label: List TFBS datasets
endpoints.describes: Filtered TFBS datasets. Filter by species (Homo sapiens / Mus musculus / Danio rerio / …), TF name, or cell/tissue type. Each dataset corresponds to one ChIP-seq experiment + JASPAR motif scan.

endpoints.label: Single TFBS dataset detail
endpoints.describes: Full record for one TFBS dataset — experimental metadata + the binding site BED file URL. Download the BED separately when you need the coordinates.
